turns.input: *He looks at Captain Doran Hale, trying to understand what kind of person he has in front of him.*
turns.draft:
In the open air of Heartstone Square, Captain Doran Hale stands broad-shouldered and upright, his practical heavy officer's armor showing honest wear rather than decorative polish. He is tall and strongly built, his head cleanly bald, weathered scars tracing across his face near steady blue eyes. The longsword at his hip hangs within easy reach, worn with the practiced unthinking balance of someone who has spent years in the field. 

The square's moderate foot traffic moves at an unhurried distance around the two men, past the low residential fronts and the dull facade of The Coined Lie nearby. Hale takes in Nicco's frame with a disciplined, assessing gaze, his posture firm and patient as he waits.

"Good day," the captain says, his voice carrying the calm, steady weight of someone accustomed to routine command. "Something I can help you with?"
